text:
Sam: noticed a tail-latency bump from ingress at ~18:09 UTC, P99 up ~35-50ms. Traces point to host preproc + gRPC chunker path.
Priya: yup, dashboards showing a spike. Not GPU/kernel. It happens before runtime decode.
Victor: any recent infra or tokenizer changes?
Sam: deploy-bot shows a roll at 17:58 labeled "ingress: chunk-scheduler v2".
deploy-bot: rolled ingress/chunk-scheduler v2: canary -> 10% -> 100% (17:58)
Priya: I reproduced with a small wrk script. P99 climbs when streaming payloads produce chunks >4KB.
Mei: perf hot path on canary nodes points to server::flush_buffers and tokenizer::normalize doing extra copies. Flamegraph: http://perf.internal/fg/235678
Alex: KV cache miss ratio increased for multi-chunk chat streams. Suspect key shapes change when chunk boundary shifts.
Victor: sounds like two bugs: (A) extra copies in preproc + chunk-flush path, (B) KV cache thrash because of framing canonicalization.
Priya: small repro: 8 concurrent streaming chats, vary prompt lengths across 1-12KB, watch ingress.parse.serialize P99 step up.
Sam: logs: 
[18:09:12] ingress: recv 4096 bytes
[18:09:12] tokenizer: read 4096 -> normalized 4352 (alloc)
[18:09:12] grpc: chunker flush -> writev(2) -> syscall
[18:09:12] kvcache: miss key_prefix="chat:usr:abc:seg:3"
Mei: quick mitigation: avoid intermediate normalization copy when chunk_size >= payload and use span-backed zero-copy path for common encodings; coalesce iovecs before writev to reduce syscalls.
Alex: KV fix: derive canonical key from pre-chunk canonical prefix (store unhashed prefix length) so chunk boundary changes don't mutate cache keys.
Victor: can we gate v2 behind feature flag and roll back?
Sam: currently at 30% subset. Rolling back reduces canary visibility but mitigates tail pain.
Priya: note: ingress chunking influences downstream batching heuristics. Smaller emitted chunks can reduce decode-side batching, hurting throughput. Noted for RG-1300 follow-up.
Mei: action list: revert writev change (Sam), add tokenizer zero-copy fastpath (Mei), change kvcache canonicalization (Alex), add chunk-boundary e2e loadtest (Priya).
Sam: opened tickets RG-1291 revert-chunker-writev, RG-1292 tokenizer-zero-copy, RG-1293 kvcache-canonical-prefix, RG-1294 chunk-boundary-e2e.
Priya: adding a perf regression alert: ingress P99 > baseline +20ms for 5m -> auto flag and rollback.
Victor: good. target hotfix by EOD. Ping infra for replay.
infra-bench-bot: queued replay job with matching UA/seq distribution: replay-235678-1
Sam: pushing revert PR now: git push origin revert/chunker-writev-235678
Alex: prototyping kvcache canonicalization locally, will run kvbench and post numbers.
Mei: landing tokenizer fastpath behind flag, will canary at 5% first.
Priya: once revert is live I'll rerun wrk and re-upload flamegraphs.
Sam: revert merged, rolling to 100% -- watching metrics :eyes:
deploy-bot: deployed revert/chunker-writev-235678 to 100% (18:43)
Priya: post-revert P99 back near baseline within ~5m. KV misses reduced but still slightly above baseline. Continuing RG-1293.
Victor: follow-up design review for chunk framing needed. Thanks all :thumbsup:
